authorization: The owner said "Okay, let's get the rest of this shipped and deployed" about the waiting lanes: the map link (#537), parallel chapter painting (#540) and the told-events climb-2 candidate. Later they said "ok continue".

release.summary: Three changes. Lean image prompt 2026-11-25-lean-v8 (#550): the four measured vF wordings, with "a teller is left out of what they tell" as the lever; on real images, told scenes went from 13/20 to 15/20 and speakers were kept 8/8. The experimental map link "See where this happened" under verses with a known place (#537), with OpenBible.info places (CC BY 4.0). A focused map marker's card returns when the pointer leaves (#551).
release.leftOut: #540 (parallel chapter painting) is still open: another session is landing its follow-ups (spec #552), and it ships in a later release with its Convex push. The uncommitted work-wide God/Yahweh renaming in the told-events-2 worktree was not shipped.

steps.convex: Not pushed: no convex/ change since production d6ce2dfa.

smoke.after: visibible.com/exodus/15/4, /psalms/23/4 and /genesis/1/1 answer 200. The map link shows only on Exodus 15:4, and Psalm 23:4 keeps its title. In Chrome at 390 and 1280 wide, the link opens the map ("Map of Red Sea, where Exodus 15:4 happened"), and Escape closes it. Nothing was painted, so lean-v8 is covered by the golden fixture and engine tests, not by a production image.
smoke.beforeRelease: Each PR: npm test (1525 to 1556 tests), tsc, CI quality-gates. CodeRabbit on #550 had no comments. #551 had a local CodeRabbit review; the paid on-demand review was not run.

spend: None in this release. The told-events climb's $2.14 was spent on the dev key on 24 November.
